decisions.reason: Although the German construction downturn keeps results below aspiration, this multi-model combined machine looks like the consolidated outcome of the problemistic search that already pruned the single-function robots A–D, so management will give it time to prove itself rather than cut again after one year.

The production analysis software is close to the core offer, cheap to carry with existing slack, and supports the firm's automation and lifecycle-service strategy, so even uncertain early results do not justify dropping it.
